sourceNotes: Values are approximate representative placeholders for ruleset tuning, not a clinical nutrient database.

sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 42.2 grams of fat. Omega 3 is 22800 milligrams, supporting a more useful fat profile. Polyunsaturated fat is 28.7 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling, and it is still a strong secondary mark. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.
sections.subtitleText: 42.2g of fat. Omega 3 is 22800mg, supporting a more useful fat profile. Polyunsaturated fat is 28.7g, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling, and it is still a strong secondary mark. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 28.9 grams of carbs. Fibre is 27.3 grams, helping with digestion and steadier meals. Starch is 1.6 grams, not bringing much steady carb energy, so that's a small downside for seeds. For seeds, fibre matters much more than raw carb totals.

sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 18.3 grams of protein. That amount is useful enough to count. Essential amino acids score is 5 out of 9, not giving much repair-and-maintenance protein support. For seeds, protein is a bonus here, but not enough by itself.
